title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 6 (DE) · „30.000 € für Implantate“ – Testimonial mit italienischem Prothetiker
format: Photoreal AI-UGC testimonial, very fast cutting (1–3 s per shot): one woman (problem part in a sage-green tee, solution part in a coral-pink tee) in her bedroom at night (fairy lights), her kitchen, a dental practice and on her porch; cut-ins of an Italian prosthodontist in his clinic; 3D cross-section models of the jaw ridge on a slate-blue background.
voice_note: Female first-person VO (the woman), German, soft, emotional, honest. Address: Sie in the call to action.
captions_note: White bold sans with a soft black shadow, 2–4 words at a time, centered (upper middle in the first 3 s, then lower middle). Green round 60-day badge top right in the CTA scenes.

shots.vo_line: Dann kühlt es ab und behält diese Form.
shots.h3_prompt: The model: the same tall block of jaw ridge with the denture segment on top; the former crescent gap is completely filled with a smooth, even layer of glossy translucent amber-gold gel (honey-colored, slightly see-through) that follows the curve of the ridge, so the denture sits fully supported. Everything holds still while the glossy gel layer settles and firms, its surface turning smooth and calm; very slow push-in with a slight orbit. Nothing else appears. One continuous shot from this exact first frame; keep the same people, faces, clothing, setting, background, lighting and colours for the whole clip. No new people, no extra hands. No new objects appear. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos appear anywhere; anything plain stays plain. Teeth, gums and dentures stay anatomically natural. Gentle natural motion, no morphing. The gel layer keeps exactly the size, colour and place it has in the first frame: it does not grow, swell, drip, melt, run or sink.
